[RBND.4b.2] The serialization is the byte sequence produced by
writing, in order:

```
1. The literal ASCII bytes "ds.contract.v1\n"
2. "wm_max="              + <int>  + "\n"
3. "agenda_cap="          + <int>  + "\n"
4. "max_fires_per_pump="  + <int>  + "\n"
5. "token_pool_cap="      + <int>  + "\n"
6. "intern_cap="          + <int>  + "\n"
7. "intern_bytes_cap="    + <int>  + "\n"
8. "pump_wcet_ns="        + <int>  + "\n"
9. "nodes="            followed by each (node_id, kind,
   capacity) triple in ascending node_id order, joined by
   ",", each formatted as "<node_id>:<kind>:<capacity>"
   where kind ∈ {"alpha", "beta", "term"}; then "\n"
10. "series="          followed by each (series_id, capacity)
    pair in ascending series_id order, joined by ",", each
    formatted as "<series_id>:<capacity>"; then "\n"
```
